Its resolvent determinant is det(I-zT)=(z-1)(55z^3+506z^2-7263z-48114)/48114, with leading coefficient 55=F_10. The three nontrivial eigenvalues are the roots of 48114 lambda^3+7263 lambda^2-506 lambda-55, numerically about -0.1736035222, -0.0706075224, and 0.0932570603, all inside the unit disk, giving spectral gap about 0.8263964778. The same kernel retains the boundary escape ratio 8/9 and is contrasted with the fine no-adjacent-one transfer operator whose Perron root is phi.
